title: 1615. Maximal Network Rank

examples.explanation: The network rank of cities 0 and 1 is 4 as there are 4 roads that are connected to either 0 or 1. The road between 0 and 1 is only counted once.
There are 5 roads that are connected to cities 1 or 2.
The network rank of 2 and 5 is 5. Notice that all the cities do not have to be connected.
